title: FlexCast: Flexible Context Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) based on autoregressive (AR) next-token prediction entangle two factors: variable-context conditioning and prediction-unit factorization with autoregressive rollout. Strong AR performance therefore does not reveal whether generalization stems from the flexible training distribution, the local prediction target, the left-to-right inference process, or their combination. We propose FlexCast, a flexible context-target learning framework that disentangles these factors. FlexCast reformulates forecasting as variable-length masked prediction over time series patches: during pretraining, it dynamically samples visible context and masked target patches, exposing the model to diverse context-target configurations without sequential decoding. translated_title: FlexCast：面向时间序列基础模型的灵活上下文学习
translated_abstract: 基于自回归（AR）下一词元预测的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）将两个因素纠缠在一起：可变上下文条件化与带有自回归展开的预测单元分解。因此，强大的AR性能无法揭示泛化能力究竟源于灵活的训练分布、局部预测目标、从左到右的推理过程，还是它们的组合。我们提出FlexCast，一种能够解耦这些因素的灵活上下文-目标学习框架。FlexCast将预测重新表述为对时间序列补丁的可变长度掩码预测：在预训练期间，它动态采样可见的上下文补丁和被掩码的目标补丁，使模型在无需顺序解码的情况下接触多样的上下文-目标配置。在推理时，同一个预训练模型通过统一的掩码预测机制，支持单步预测、基于置信度的迭代细化以及下一词元式的生成。
tldr: FlexCast通过对时间序列补丁进行可变长度掩码预测的预训练框架，解耦了上下文条件化与自回归这两个因素，使同一个预训练模型能够灵活支持单步预测、置信度迭代细化和自回归式生成等多种推理方式。
en_tdlr: FlexCast disentangles variable-context conditioning from autoregressive rollout in time series foundation models by reformulating forecasting as variable-length masked patch prediction, enabling a single pretrained model to flexibly support one-step forecasting, confidence-based iterative refinement, and next-token-style generation.
